def transform(grid):
    grid = [list(row) for row in grid]
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    output = []
    for i in range(n):
        output.append(grid[i] + clockwise[i])
    for i in range(n):
        output.append(counterclockwise[i] + half_turn[i])
    return output
